remarks: Introducing the HELIX by Coventry Homes! This beautifully designed open-concept home offers a SEPARATE ENTRANCE & 9' ceilings on both the main floor & basement, creating a bright, spacious feel. The stunning rear kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a central island, large pantry & a window above the sink overlooking the backyard. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the inviting Great Room & dining area, perfect for everyday living & entertaining. A convenient half bath completes the main floor. Upstairs, retreat to the spacious primary suite featuring a luxurious 5 pc ensuite w/ dual sinks & a walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms, a full bath & upstairs laundry offer comfort & convenience for the whole family. A double attached garage adds even more functionality. Built with care & backed by the Alberta New Home Warranty Program. *Home is under construction* (id:67522)
